svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: ADS7952: Typical application
svg.desc: Schematic of the ADS7952 typical application: the chip with U2 MCU, U3 REF5025, C1 capacitor 10 µF, C2 capacitor 1 µF, C3 capacitor 1 µF, C4 capacitor 150 pF, C5 capacitor 150 pF; the MCU wires carry the port hooks Transfer().
svg.text: Figure 60: MXO shorted to AINP, an external 2.5 V reference on REFP with 10 µF to REFM, and the SPI lines to the host. Each supply pin
has its 1 µF capacitor (section 10); each used input has 150 pF to ground against the multiplexer's charge kick (section 9.1) and a source
of 50 Ω or less. Above each MCU wire: the port hook that drives it. Datasheet: 9.1.1 Analog Input, Figure 60, p. 46.
* Not confirmed in the datasheet: U3: Figure 60 shows only the reference's output; its supply and decoupling are the reference's own; net +5V: example +VA; the
datasheet allows 2.7 V to 5.25 V; net +3V3: example +VBD; the datasheet allows 1.7 V to +VA.
